## SigningBackend.signWithKey() method

Sign `data` with the private key stored under `id`<!-- -->, returning the raw signature bytes. The private key never leaves the backend.

**Signature:**

```typescript
signWithKey(id: string, data: Buffer): Promise<Buffer>;
```
